How to generate a RESTful API request on Cisco Nexus Dashboard?
version:3.1.0
IP:192.168.11.33
API name: get nodes list
Parameter_fabricName:PEK-ACI

function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends an HTTP GET request to retrieve a list of nodes associated with a specified fabric in a network. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to send the GET request to. The URL should include the target IP, API endpoint, and the fabricName query parameter placeholder https://<ip>/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/nodes?fabricName={fabricName}.

fabricName.description: The name of the fabric whose nodes are to be listed. This value is used to replace the {fabricName} placeholder in the URL.

We need to replace <ip> with the IP provided: 192.168.11.33. And fabricName placeholder with the provided Parameter_fabricName: PEK-ACI.

Thus the URL becomes: "https://192.168.11.33/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/nodes?fabricName=PEK-ACI".

We need to call the function requests_get with fabricName: "PEK-ACI". The url can be omitted because default uses placeholder but we need to override it? The default url uses <ip> placeholder. But we can supply url explicitly: "https://192.168.11.33/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/nodes?fabricName=PEK-ACI". Or we can just supply fabricName and let default use placeholder? But default uses <ip> placeholder which is not replaced automatically. So we need to supply url explicitly.

  "arguments": {
    "url": "https://192.168.11.33/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/nodes?fabricName=PEK-ACI",
    "fabricName": "PEK-ACI"

}
